svg.aria-label: School start times — twenty ranked arguments
svg.title: Should high schools start at 8:30 a.m. or later?
svg.desc: Seven distinct central colors mark the highest priorities. Six surrounding pieces lead to seven smaller pieces at the perimeter. The symbol beside each rank shows the stance.
svg.text: Should high schools start at 8:30 a.m. or later?
